title: Lifting points and structural stalk germs through affine localization
statement: Let R,S be commutative rings, S an R-algebra localizing a submonoid M. Let c:Y->X, f:Y->Spec S and g:X->Spec R form a cartesian square with Spec(algebraMap R S). If x is a point of X and M is disjoint from the prime ideal of g(x), there is x0 in Y with c(x0)=x and a ring equivalence e:O_{Y,x0}->O_{X,x}. For every r in R it sends the f-structural germ of algebraMap(r) to the g-structural germ of r.

source.document: Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Stalk; Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Ideal; original root localization comparison proof
source.place: Localization prime correspondence and transitivity; lem-sbc-root-normalization-localization-comparison step 3

proof.text: PrimeSpectrum.localization_comap_range puts g(x) in the image of Spec(algebraMap R S) from the disjointness assumption. Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback supplies x0 with c(x0)=x.

IsPreimmersion.of_isLocalization and IsLocalization.flat show that the localization spectrum map is a flat preimmersion. Flat.SpecMap_iff and MorphismProperty.of_isPullback transfer both properties to c. Its stalk map at x0 is surjective. Flat.stalkMap and Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom make that map faithfully flat; RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.injective makes it injective. Invert it using RingEquiv.ofBijective.

Apply Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_hom to the commuting square and expand both composite stalk maps with stalkMap_comp. Transport the coefficient-to-stalk map along the equality of image points (by equality induction). AlgebraicGeometry.stalkMap_toStalk identifies the localization-spectrum coefficient germ. Evaluate the resulting equality of ring homomorphisms at r and use injectivity of the inverse equivalence to establish the required formula.

theorem exists_lift_stalkEquiv_of_isLocalization
    (R S : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (c : Y ⟶ X) (f : Y ⟶ Spec S) (g : X ⟶ Spec R)
    (hsq : IsPullback c f g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))))
    (x : X) (hx : Disjoint (M : Set R) ((g x).asIdeal : Set R)) :
    ∃ x0 : Y, c x0 = x ∧
      ∃ e : Y.presheaf.stalk x0 ≃+* X.presheaf.stalk x,
        ∀ r : R,
          e ((f.stalkMap x0).hom
            (StructureSheaf.toStalk S (f x0) (algebraMap R S r))) =
              (g.stalkMap x).hom (StructureSheaf.toStalk R (g x) r)
